WP-CLI Guide: Manage WordPress From the Command Line (Commands That Earn Their Keep)

Quick thread 🧵
WP-CLI runs WordPress tasks from the terminal instead of the dashboard: updates, users, database export, cache flush, and the migration hero `wp search-replace`.
You run it over SSH on the server where the site lives, which any real (managed) server gives you.
Rule one: `wp db export` before anything that changes data.
